questions.prompt: Resource group rg-app has CostCenter=Finance. An administrator deploys vm-app into it without specifying VM tags. No tagging policy or other automation applies. Which pair of resource tag states should the administrator observe after deployment?

options.text: rg-app retains CostCenter=Finance; vm-app has no CostCenter tag.
options.explanation: Tags remain on the group; resource tags do not automatically inherit to the VM.

options.text: rg-app and vm-app both have CostCenter=Finance.
options.explanation: That would require explicit tagging or automation; no automatic resource-tag inheritance applies.

options.text: rg-app has no CostCenter tag; vm-app has CostCenter=Finance.
options.explanation: Deploying a VM neither transfers nor removes the group tag.

options.text: Neither rg-app nor vm-app has a CostCenter tag.
options.explanation: The deployment does not remove the existing group tag.

questions.prompt: A resource has ServiceOwner=Ops and no Environment tag. The shell variable resourceId contains its valid resource ID. You must add Environment=Training without removing ServiceOwner. Which command meets both requirements?

options.explanation: Merge adds the new key while preserving the existing ServiceOwner key.
Create replaces the collection, so ServiceOwner would be removed.
Replace retains only the supplied collection, which omits ServiceOwner.
Delete removes matching tags; it cannot add the missing Environment key.

questions.prompt: Existing supported resources need the CostCenter resource tag copied from their resource group. Which approach can apply that change across the existing population?

options.text: A suitable Modify tag policy and remediation task.
options.explanation: It can apply the parent-derived value to existing noncompliant resources.
Audit can identify missing tags but does not write them.
That affects cost records, not necessarily the resources' tag properties.

options.text: Retag the resource group and assume automatic propagation.
options.explanation: Parent resource tags do not automatically copy to children.
